mentions.name: tinyrenderer
mentions.description: A work-in-progress pure C implementation of the tinyrenderer computer graphics tutorial, worked through from first principles up to the early shading lessons, including a side-quest hand-written TGA image file reader and writer. Texture mapping is not yet finished.
mentions.source_excerpt: I got this itch too when I came across tinyrenderer [1] and worked through the early lessons through shading, but didn't quite finish the texture mapping yet [2]. It was fun to work in pure C from first principles, even side-questing to write a simple TGA file reader and writer.
